svg.title: Frozen-estimator marginal SBC under the original prior
svg.desc: Computed rank histograms for all 26 parameters: 20 equal-width bins of normalized randomized ranks from 1,000 calibration cases, with the uniform expectation of 50 per bin (dashed) and a pointwise 95% binomial reference band (37-64 counts) for each bin.
svg.text: Frozen-estimator marginal SBC under the original prior
1,000 cases; 10,000 conditional draws per case; all 26 parameters
All 26 rank-uniformity tests reject after Holm correction at 0.05.
